meta.source: Stark et al. 2021 dog model (SimTK dogmodel), MIT; bone meshes from full_linear/Geometry (same files as forelimb_verified), default pose
meta.frame: side view, dog facing right: x = forward (= -model Y), y = down (= -model Z). Origin = top of the thoracic spinous processes (withers) in x and y; ground (lowest paw-mesh point) is at y = +1 WH.
meta.units: "m" = metres; "wh" = fractions of withers height (WH, ground to top of thoracic spinous processes)
meta.method: all triangles of each body's meshes projected to the side view, rasterised at 0.5 mm, closed (~1 mm), holes filled, outer contour traced (marching squares, skimage.find_contours), simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 1 mm tolerance. Each value is a list of parts (polygons); usually one part. Polygons are open (last point != first).
meta.bodies: one outline per model body: thorax = thoracic vertebrae + ribs + sternum; cervix = cervical vertebrae; caput = skull + mandible; abdomen = lumbar vertebrae; cauda = tail vertebrae; pelvis = os coxae + sacrum; carpus = carpal bones + metacarpals; forepaw = fore digits; calx = tarsus + metatarsals; hindpaw = hind digits. right_* bones are the near side in this view, left_* the far side.
meta.not_volumes: outlines are bone silhouettes, not skin.
